entities.name: Veldrane
entities.description: Veldrane of Sengir, the Baron Sengir's most loyal minion on Ulgrotha: a poacher, scout and messenger.

entities.name: Baron Sengir
entities.description: Master of Veldrane who rules the Dark Barony from Castle Sengir.

entities.name: Ulgrotha
entities.description: Plane where Veldrane served the Baron Sengir.

entities.name: Autumn Willow
entities.description: Secret power of the Great Wood, who created Devin as a joke against Veldrane.

entities.name: Devin
entities.description: Faerie Noble created by Autumn Willow as a miniature replica of Veldrane.

entities.name: Great Wood
entities.description: Forest into which Veldrane led hunting missions.

events.summary: Veldrane, the Baron's best hunter, leads successful missions into the Great Wood but fails to discover the Autumn Willow.
events.quote: neither Veldrane nor any other hunters were able to discover the Autumn Willow

events.summary: Autumn Willow creates Devin as a miniature replica of Veldrane, as a joke.

relations.quote: Veldrane of Sengir was one of the Baron Sengir 's minions on Ulgrotha and his most loyal servant.

relations.note: Created as a joke against Veldrane
